Question 4
?

Find the general solution to the differential equation f′(x)−6e−3x=1.

a
f(x)=x−2e−3x+C
b
f(x)=x+e−3x+C
c
f(x)=x−18e−3x+C
d
f(x)=2(x+9e−3x)+C
e
f(x)=2(x−3e−3x)+C
